parameters.name: ui.locale
parameters.description: Language used by the built-in assistant UI. "auto" follows the browser language.

parameters.name: ui.theme
parameters.description: Theme for the built-in surfaces. An object can override tokens or choose a mode.
parameters.descriptionZh: 内置界面的主题。传对象时可选择模式或覆盖设计令牌。

parameters.name: ui.theme.mode
parameters.description: Explicit mode when the theme is an object. "auto" follows the operating-system preference.
parameters.descriptionZh: 主题传对象时指定的模式。`auto` 跟随操作系统外观。

parameters.name: ui.theme.tokens
parameters.description: Overrides individual design tokens such as colours, radii, shadows, and font families. Keys not supplied keep the selected light or dark defaults.
parameters.descriptionZh: 覆盖颜色、圆角、阴影、字体等单个设计令牌。未提供的键沿用所选明色或暗色主题的默认值。

parameters.name: ui.messages
parameters.description: Adds or replaces message catalog entries for one or more locales.
parameters.descriptionZh: 为一个或多个语言补充或替换界面文案。

parameters.name: ui.messages.<locale>
parameters.description: Message overrides for one BCP 47 locale. Missing keys fall back to the built-in catalog.
parameters.descriptionZh: 某个 BCP 47 语言的文案覆盖。未提供的键回退到内置文案。

parameters.name: ui.classNames
parameters.description: Extra class names applied to the built-in chat, dock, launcher, and panel.
parameters.descriptionZh: 为内置对话、浮窗、启动按钮和面板附加 class。

parameters.name: ui.classNames.dock
parameters.description: Extra class for the dock shell.
parameters.descriptionZh: 浮窗外壳的附加 class。

parameters.name: ui.classNames.panel
parameters.description: Extra class for the panel shell.
parameters.descriptionZh: 面板外壳的附加 class。

parameters.name: ui.classNames.launcher
parameters.description: Extra class for the launcher button.
parameters.descriptionZh: 启动按钮的附加 class。

parameters.name: ui.classNames.chat
parameters.description: Extra class for the chat surface.
parameters.descriptionZh: 对话界面的附加 class。

parameters.name: onWarn
parameters.description: Receives development warnings and declaration diagnostics. Defaults to console.warn.
parameters.descriptionZh: 接收开发期告警和声明诊断。默认输出到 `console.warn`。

parameters.name: registry
parameters.description: Uses an existing action registry instead of creating one. Do not combine it with shared.
parameters.descriptionZh: 使用已有动作注册表，而不是新建一个。不要与 `shared` 同时传入。

parameters.name: shared
parameters.description: Joins a page runtime shared by several framework islands. registry and scopes are then owned by that page runtime.
parameters.descriptionZh: 接入多个框架孤岛共用的页面运行时。此时 `registry` 与 `scopes` 由页面统一持有。

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Prefixes action and record ids for this adapter instance, for example add becomes todo/add.
parameters.descriptionZh: 为该适配器实例的动作与记录 id 加前缀，例如 `add` 变成 `todo/add`。

parameters.name: scopes
parameters.description: Overrides visibility and hit-testing behavior. Intended for tests and unusual rendering hosts.
parameters.descriptionZh: 覆盖可见性与命中测试行为。主要用于测试和特殊渲染宿主。

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Wires the model, hooks, confirmation, continuity, and observability used by built-in assistant surfaces.
parameters.descriptionZh: 接线内置助手界面使用的模型、钩子、确认、连续性与观测能力。

parameters.name: derive
parameters.description: Enables optional L1 derivation from native clickable elements. Disabled by default; derived actions are marked as guesses.
parameters.descriptionZh: 开启可选的 L1 派生：从原生可点击元素推断动作。默认关闭；派生动作会标记为推断结果。

parameters.name: presence
parameters.description: Controls target highlighting while the agent operates the page.
parameters.descriptionZh: 控制 agent 操作页面时的目标高亮。

parameters.name: revealSensitive
parameters.description: Restores sensitive-value tokens to their real values in the rendered chat only. Model requests and storage keep the tokens.
parameters.descriptionZh: 仅在渲染层把敏感值代号还原为真值。发给模型的请求和存储中仍保留代号。

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: Required model-facing description of what the control or operation does. This is the primary signal used to select the tool.
parameters.descriptionZh: 必填的面向模型说明，描述控件或操作做什么。这是模型选择工具时最主要的依据。

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Stable action id. Omit only for one-off controls; list rows and flows should use stable ids.
parameters.descriptionZh: 稳定动作 id。仅一次性控件可以省略；列表行与流程应显式提供。

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Risk level used for approval and auditing. Omitted values are fail-closed and treated as write.
parameters.descriptionZh: 用于确认与审计的风险等级。省略时按 fail-closed 视为 `write`。

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Overrides approval derivation. false skips confirmation, true requires it, and always never offers a persistent allow option.
parameters.descriptionZh: 覆盖确认推导。`false` 跳过确认，`true` 要求确认，`always` 每次询问且不提供长期允许。

parameters.name: modelVisible
parameters.description: Keeps the action out of the model tool list and snapshot while page code and task steps can still invoke it. This is a visibility boundary, not a permission check.
parameters.descriptionZh: 让动作不出现在模型工具清单与动作快照中，但页面代码和任务步骤仍可调用。这是可见性边界，不是权限校验。

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Overrides primitive inference. By default form inputs use fill and other elements use click.
parameters.descriptionZh: 覆盖动作原语推断。默认表单输入使用填写，其余元素使用点击。

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Key used by an action whose primitive is press.
parameters.descriptionZh: 原语为按键时使用的键名。

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Explicit region id. Omitted values inherit the nearest declared scope.
parameters.descriptionZh: 显式区域 id。省略时继承最近声明的区域。

parameters.name: fidelity
parameters.description: Declares how trustworthy the execution target is. Setting it stops automatic target relocation.
parameters.descriptionZh: 声明执行目标的可靠程度。显式设置后不再自动定位目标。

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: CSS selector, scoped to the declared element, used to choose the concrete target.
parameters.descriptionZh: 限定在声明元素内部查找具体目标的 CSS 选择器。

parameters.name: autoTarget
parameters.description: Automatically locates a unique native control inside the declared element.
parameters.descriptionZh: 自动定位声明元素内部唯一的原生控件。

parameters.name: available
parameters.description: Business precondition checked before the action appears as available. A returned string is shown to the model as the reason.
parameters.descriptionZh: 动作出现前检查的业务前置条件。返回字符串时，该字符串会作为不可用原因交给模型。

parameters.name: expect
parameters.description: Success criterion checked after execution. Failure produces EXPECTATION_FAILED instead of a false success.
parameters.descriptionZh: 执行后检查的成功判据。不成立时返回 `EXPECTATION_FAILED`，不会把未完成当成功。

parameters.name: handoff
parameters.description: Hands the step to the user instead of simulating it. The boolean or string form supplies the reason.
parameters.descriptionZh: 把这一步交给用户完成，而不是模拟操作。布尔值或字符串形式提供原因。

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Parameter schema for the parameterized form. When present, run receives the validated parameter object rather than a single primitive value.
parameters.descriptionZh: 带参数表单使用的参数声明。存在时，`run` 收到校验后的参数对象，而不是单个原语值。

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: Injected implementation. Atomic actions receive the primitive value; parameterized actions receive the full argument object. Ignored when steps is present.
parameters.descriptionZh: 注入的执行实现。原子动作收到原语值；带参数动作收到完整参数对象。写了 `steps` 时不会运行。

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Turns the declaration into a single model-facing flow that executes registered action ids in order. Do not combine it with run.
parameters.descriptionZh: 把声明变成对模型可见的单个流程，按顺序执行已注册动作 id。不要与 `run` 同时使用。

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Partial model and runtime configuration. Omitted fields are read from VITE_AGENT_* environment variables or framework defaults.
parameters.descriptionZh: 模型与运行时的局部配置。未写的字段从 `VITE_AGENT_*` 环境变量或框架默认值读取。

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Bounds the page information included in model context, including the live clock.
parameters.descriptionZh: 设置进入模型上下文的页面信息上限，也可配置每轮读取的实时时钟。

parameters.name: clock
parameters.description: Adds the current instant, viewer timezone, and business timezone to every model request. This is context only; business services remain authoritative for writes.
parameters.descriptionZh: 每次模型请求都附带当前时刻、用户时区和业务时区。它只提供上下文；写入仍以业务服务校验为准。

parameters.name: llm
parameters.description: Injects the model call function. Use it for a test model, a server proxy, or a non-OpenAI-compatible transport.
parameters.descriptionZh: 注入模型调用函数。可用于测试模型、服务端代理或非 OpenAI 兼容传输。

parameters.name: responseLocale
parameters.description: Locale used when composing the response-language instruction. A function is re-read before each model request.
parameters.descriptionZh: 拼接回答语言约束时使用的语言。传函数时，每次模型请求前重新读取。

parameters.name: telemetry
parameters.description: Collects token, duration, cost, and retry metrics for the current runtime.
parameters.descriptionZh: 收集当前运行时的 token、耗时、成本与重试指标。

parameters.name: trace
parameters.description: Keeps a bounded in-memory trace of model requests for the read-only inspector. Disabled by default.
parameters.descriptionZh: 在内存中保留有界的模型请求记录，供只读诊断面板查看。默认关闭。

parameters.name: settle
parameters.description: Replaces the page-settle wait used between actions. Most useful in deterministic tests and non-browser hosts.
parameters.descriptionZh: 替换动作之间的页面落定等待。主要用于确定性测试和非浏览器宿主。

parameters.name: hooks
parameters.description: Tool lifecycle hooks shared by every surface created from this application runtime.
parameters.descriptionZh: 由该应用运行时创建的界面共用的工具生命周期钩子。

parameters.name: onEvent
parameters.description: Receives the same session event stream that powers the chat and activity views.
parameters.descriptionZh: 接收与对话、运行视图相同的会话事件流。

parameters.name: onApproval
parameters.description: Called when an approval request appears or clears. Use it to connect a custom approval UI.
parameters.descriptionZh: 确认请求出现或清除时调用。可用来接自己的确认界面。

parameters.name: onHandoff
parameters.description: Called when a human-handoff request appears or clears.
parameters.descriptionZh: 人工接力请求出现或清除时调用。

parameters.name: policy
parameters.description: Replaces the default approval gate. When provided, the built-in gate and chat approval buttons are not used.
parameters.descriptionZh: 替换默认确认闸门。传入后不再使用内置闸门和对话中的确认按钮。

parameters.name: approvalTimeoutMs
parameters.description: Time to wait for a human approval before treating it as denied.
parameters.descriptionZh: 等待人工确认的最长时间；超时按拒绝处理。

parameters.name: handoffTimeoutMs
parameters.description: Default time to wait for a human handoff. A tool-level handoff.timeout overrides it.
parameters.descriptionZh: 人工接力的默认等待时间。单个工具的 `handoff.timeout` 可以覆盖。

parameters.name: handoff
parameters.description: Replaces the built-in handoff queue with a custom channel.
parameters.descriptionZh: 用自定义通道替换内置人工接力队列。

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Stable session id for multi-session hosts.
parameters.descriptionZh: 多会话宿主使用的稳定会话 id。

parameters.name: onLeaseLost
parameters.description: Called when another tab or host takes over the shared session lease.
parameters.descriptionZh: 共享会话租约被另一个标签页或宿主接管时调用。

parameters.name: continuity
parameters.description: Enables bounded conversation continuity across full-page navigation. "tab" uses sessionStorage. Omit to disable it.
parameters.descriptionZh: 开启跨整页导航的有界对话连续性。`"tab"` 使用 sessionStorage；省略即关闭。

parameters.name: gate
parameters.description: Returns false to disable the built-in confirmation channel for this application. Defaults to enabled.
parameters.descriptionZh: 返回 `false` 时关闭该应用的内置确认通道。默认开启。

parameters.name: [].name
parameters.description: Argument key received by run and visible to the model.
parameters.descriptionZh: `run` 收到的参数键，也是模型看到的参数名。

parameters.name: [].label
parameters.description: Required explanation of the argument. It is the model's only semantic hint.
parameters.descriptionZh: 必填的参数说明，是模型唯一可依赖的语义提示。

parameters.name: [].type
parameters.description: Argument type. Includes coercion from obvious string forms and rejects invalid values.
parameters.descriptionZh: 参数类型。会把明显的字符串形式规整为对应类型，并拒绝无效值。

parameters.name: [].optional
parameters.description: Marks the argument optional. Arguments are required by default.
parameters.descriptionZh: 把参数标为可选。参数默认必填。

parameters.name: [].values
parameters.description: Closed static value set. Use it when the model must choose from known values.
parameters.descriptionZh: 静态封闭值集合。模型只能从已知值里选择时使用。

parameters.name: [].options
parameters.description: Dynamic value set, re-read for each snapshot and execution.
parameters.descriptionZh: 动态值集合，每次快照与执行前重新读取。

parameters.name: [].min | [].max
parameters.description: Numeric bounds for number arguments, including dynamic bounds.
parameters.descriptionZh: 数字参数的上下界，也支持动态边界。

parameters.name: [].minLength | [].maxLength
parameters.description: String length bounds.
parameters.descriptionZh: 字符串长度边界。

parameters.name: [].pattern
parameters.description: Regular-expression constraint for a string argument.
parameters.descriptionZh: 字符串参数的正则约束。

parameters.name: [].format
parameters.description: Semantic format validation. A date must be a real calendar date.
parameters.descriptionZh: 语义格式校验。`date` 还要求是真实存在的日期。

parameters.name: JSON Schema.type
parameters.description: The direct JSON Schema form must describe an object.
parameters.descriptionZh: 直接传 JSON Schema 时，根类型必须是对象。

parameters.name: JSON Schema.properties
parameters.description: Property schemas for the direct JSON Schema form.
parameters.descriptionZh: 直接 JSON Schema 形式的属性定义。

parameters.name: JSON Schema.required
parameters.description: Required property names for the direct JSON Schema form.
parameters.descriptionZh: 直接 JSON Schema 形式的必填属性名。

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Globally unique action id used by the model.
parameters.descriptionZh: 模型调用时使用的全局唯一动作 id。

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: Required semantic description of the operation.
parameters.descriptionZh: 必填的操作语义说明。

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Risk level. Omitted values are fail-closed and treated as write.
parameters.descriptionZh: 风险等级。省略时按 fail-closed 视为 `write`。

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Overrides the normal approval policy.
parameters.descriptionZh: 覆盖常规确认策略。

parameters.name: modelVisible
parameters.description: Keeps the action out of the model tool list and snapshot while page code and task steps can still invoke it. This is a visibility boundary, not a permission check.
parameters.descriptionZh: 让动作不出现在模型工具清单与动作快照中，但页面代码和任务步骤仍可调用。这是可见性边界，不是权限校验。

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Argument schema and validation; run receives the normalized object.
parameters.descriptionZh: 参数声明与校验；`run` 收到规整后的参数对象。

parameters.name: available

parameters.descriptionZh: 前置条件检查。返回字符串时，会作为不可用原因交给模型。

parameters.name: expect
parameters.description: Success criterion checked after run completes.
parameters.descriptionZh: `run` 完成后的成功判据。

parameters.name: run

parameters.descriptionZh: 校验后的实现。执行前会还原敏感值代号。

parameters.descriptionZh: 打开任务，可带初始字段值与页面已选记录。

parameters.name: close()
parameters.description: Returns to the catalog or hides the card without destroying the controller.
parameters.descriptionZh: 返回目录或隐藏任务卡，不销毁控制器。

parameters.name: refresh()
parameters.description: Re-renders from the controller's current snapshot.
parameters.descriptionZh: 按控制器当前快照重新渲染。

parameters.name: setCatalog(visible)
parameters.description: Shows or hides the task catalog while preserving the active run and its values.
parameters.descriptionZh: 显示或隐藏任务目录，同时保留当前运行及其字段值。
